senses.en: the line or area that separates two countries or regions

example.en: They crossed the border at dawn.
example.zh: 他们在黎明时越过了边界。

example.en: She planted flowers along the border of the garden.
example.zh: 她沿着花园的边缘种了花。

senses.en: to form a line along the edge of something or be next to it

example.en: A small river borders the field.
example.zh: 一条小河沿着田野的边缘流过。

senses.en: to be very close to a particular quality or state

example.en: His jokes sometimes border on rudeness.
example.zh: 他的玩笑有时近乎无礼。
